_comment: What this registry knows about. A Service List Provider registers its entry points here.
TS 103 770 V1.2.1 clause 5.1.3.2 leaves how a registry collects and stores this information out
of scope, so a JSON file is as valid as a database and is easier to read in a reference
implementation. Each offering is filtered against the query parameters of that same clause.
delivery   which of the DeliveryType children to emit, from: dash, dvb-t, dvb-c, dvb-s, rtsp,
multicast-ts, application. A query carries the table 12b values instead (dvb-dash,
dvb-t, dvb-c, dvb-s, dvb-iptv, application) and the server maps between the two.
regulator  true if this list is the one published by a national regulator, matched by the
regulatorListFlag query parameter and written as regulatorListFlag="true".
the values three DeliveryType children cannot be emitted without (clause 5.3.6):
the ApplicationTypes of ApplicationDelivery; xmlAitApplicationType is required when
contentType is application/vnd.dvb.ait+xml. A delivery declared without valid values
here is not emitted, does not match a Delivery query, and is logged as a warning.
